message:
docs(release): the candidate cannot have come from the commit it names

The build commit was recorded as 6973354. That tree has kProductVersion =
0.2.105, and the installer contains 0.2.106 three times as UTF-16 and 0.2.105
not at all -- so it is not a binary that tree can produce. The version bump
landed in e32b656, and that is the tree the artifacts came from.

Not a claim from a string, an exclusion by one: the compiled constant
differs, so that commit is ruled out. Provenance on a release candidate is
the thing that lets someone find the code later, and a wrong one costs
exactly that.
